user.title: Partition Map
user.description: Adds a GParted-style view of your disks and partitions to the sidebar (admins only) and watches storage space.

data_description.admin_notify_target: Notification service or notify entity for storage alerts, for example notify.mobile_app_pixel_9. Pre-filled when another of your integrations already defines it. Leave empty to only get persistent notifications.

error.invalid_target: Enter a notification service or a notify entity starting with notify., for example notify.mobile_app_pixel_9.

abort.not_supervised: Partition Map needs Home Assistant OS or Supervised: disk data comes from the Supervisor.

data_description.admin_notify_target: Notification service or notify entity for storage alerts. Leave empty to only get persistent notifications.
data_description.warning_threshold: Usage percentage that triggers a warning.
data_description.critical_threshold: Usage percentage that triggers a critical alert. Must be above the warning threshold.
data_description.include_mounts: Also watch backup and media shares added under Settings > System > Storage.
data_description.detail_level: Simple only lists the data partitions (hassos-data…) under each bar; HAOS system partitions stay visible in the bar. Detailed lists every partition.

error.invalid_target: Enter a notification service or a notify entity starting with notify., for example notify.mobile_app_pixel_9.
error.critical_below_warning: The critical threshold must be above the warning threshold.
